payments.label: Payments
payments.fallback: Take payment manually: use a backup card terminal, cash, or a text/email invoice to collect later. Write every transaction on the paper log so nothing gets lost.
printItems: Backup card terminal provider name & support number

email.label: Email
email.fallback: Switch to phone or text for anything urgent. Log into the backup email account (webmail or a personal account) only for messages that truly can't wait.
printItems: Printed contact list of regular clients & vendors
IT/vendor support number for the outage

scheduling.label: Scheduling / Booking
scheduling.fallback: Take bookings by phone and write them straight onto the paper day-sheet. Confirm each one back to the customer by text.
printItems: Blank day-sheet template for the week
This week's bookings, printed fresh each morning

phone.label: Phone / Communications
phone.fallback: Forward the main line to a staff cell phone and post that number at the front desk. Use it for both incoming and outgoing calls until service returns.
printItems: Staff cell number taped to the front desk
Script for staff answering on a personal phone
Backup messaging app list (who has what)

website.label: Website / Online Orders
website.fallback: Post a notice on social media and the front door directing people to call or visit. Take orders by phone or in person and write them on the paper order form.
printItems: Pre-written 'we're taking orders by phone' social post

inventory.label: Inventory / POS
inventory.fallback: Switch to a paper sales log. Use a calculator for totals and record item, quantity and price for later entry once the system is back.

security.label: Security / Access
security.fallback: Switch to physical keys and a manual sign-in sheet at the desk. Call the alarm or security company's direct line if the system can't be reached.
printItems: Note of where physical keys are kept

accounting.label: Accounting / Payroll
accounting.fallback: Record hours and transactions on paper. Either process payroll manually from those sheets or agree with staff on a short delay once the system restores.
printItems: Bank's direct phone number for urgent transfers

other.label: Other
other.fallback: Write down the manual workaround for this specific tool, and who on the team knows how to run it by hand.
printItems: Blank manual-process note for this tool
